text:
raja_cs: Heads-up: NimbusRetail down ~70% in active seats over 11 days. Champion (Priya) left last week; new lead Miro unresponsive. Saw procurement doc referencing VendorZ in our intel. Possible renewal risk.

leslie_csm: thanks raja. renewal date? any billing/contract flags?

raja_cs: renewal in 29 days. billing clean. CRM note: champion removed, PM field updated but no reply to outreach.

noah_eng: any perf regressions? 5xx/latency/429s?

raja_cs: no perf issues reported. drop is volume/seat-driven, embedding-heavy.

noah_eng: i'll pull a quick usage delta and top endpoints. give me 24h.

tess_rev: looping in renewals. if procurement is pinging VendorZ we should prepare a focused retention offer (short pilot, cost credits). need committed tier vs current usage.

leslie_csm: playbook suggestion: 1) 48h ping + small credit 2) tech healthcall with noah 3) ROI + pilot proposal from tess. thoughts?

raja_cs: +1. add Redwood Optimize quickscan (2-week) to show batching/quantization cost wins.

renewals-bot: Reminder: renewal-30d alert sent to @tess_rev and @leslie_csm for account nimbusretail.

noah_eng: prepping token / endpoint breakdown. will demo a quantized profile that keeps quality. need sample prompts from their top flows.

tess_rev: i'll draft a 3-month pilot one-pager and conservative price comparison vs VendorZ. please attach usage chart and seat churn.

leslie_csm: i'll schedule outreach for tomorrow afternoon and lead contact. raja, update CRM and tag as "at-risk: renewal window".

raja_cs: done. outreach scheduled. Miro replied auto-reply (OOTO) until Friday. will update thread after meeting.

leslie_csm: goal: convert to constrained pilot vs full RFP. act fast. :crossed_fingers:

raja_cs: quick note: procurement asked for latency percentiles and cost per 1k tokens in a vendor comparison. adding to asks.

noah_eng: i'll include p50/p95 latency, token breakdown, and a simple quant demo.

raja_cs: thanks team. will post meeting notes and next steps after Friday call.
